relationships.description: Global approaches significantly outperformed conventional vector RAG in both comprehensiveness and diversity criteria across datasets.
GraphRAG approaches were compared to source text summarization (TS) in empowerment comparisons.
Using an LLM to analyze LLM reasoning indicated that the ability to provide specific examples, quotes, and citations was key.
Community summaries generally provided a small but consistent improvement in answer comprehensiveness and diversity compared to source texts.
For low-level community summaries (C3), GraphRAG required 26-33% fewer context tokens.
For root-level community summaries (C0), GraphRAG required over 97% fewer tokens.
Table 3 shows results for the average number of extracted claims (claim-based measure).
